# Sand Hills Storage

> Four self-storage facilities in the Hutchinson, Kansas area — climate-controlled units in Hutchinson, drive-up units in South Hutchinson, Buhler and Haven. Locally owned, month-to-month, no hidden fees.

## About

Sand Hills Storage rents self-storage units across south-central Kansas from four locations. Every location is month-to-month with no long contract and no hidden fees, and units can be rented online or over the phone. The Hutchinson facility on N Plum St has climate-controlled units; the other three are drive-up. The business is locally owned and veteran-owned.

## Locations

### Hutchinson (climate-controlled)
- Address: 4601 N Plum St, Hutchinson, KS 67502
- Units from $105/month
- Sizes: 5x10, 8x10, 10x10, 10x15, 10x20, 20x20
- Climate-controlled units available

### South Hutchinson
- Address: 10 E Ave C, South Hutchinson, KS 67505
- Units from $65/month
- Sizes: 5x10, 10x10, 10x15, 10x20, 10x30
- Drive-up access

### Buhler
- Address: 305 Industrial Park Rd, Buhler, KS 67522
- Units from $65/month
- Sizes: 5x10, 10x10, 10x20, 10x30
- Drive-up access

### Haven
- Address: 601 E Arlington Rd, Haven, KS 67543
- Units from $65/month
- Sizes: 5x10, 10x10, 10x20, 10x30
- Drive-up access

## Contact and hours

- Phone: (620) 543-5925
- Office hours: Mon-Sat 9am-6pm, Sunday Noon-4pm
- All four locations are reached on the same phone number.

## Features

- Month-to-month leases, no long-term contract
- Climate-controlled units in Hutchinson
- Drive-up access in South Hutchinson, Buhler and Haven
- Rent online or by phone; online payments
- Tenant protection plans available
- No hidden fees
